title: What Non-city Vistors Need To Know About Parking at Balboa Park
description:
Not a city of San Diego resident? Our staff help explain what visitors and those living outside of the city of San Diego need to know about free and paid parking at Balboa Park. 

Generally, you’ll need to use the parking kiosks located around the park to purchase parking, unless you’re looking for long-term monthly or annual passes. Those are available at sandiego.thepermitportal.com.  

Follow the signs posted in each parking lot to determine the daily and hourly rates.  

You CAN still park for free in Balboa Park. The Lower Inspiration Point lot is free for up to three hours and there’s a free tram available to transport you to the center of Balboa Park.
